FIXED AMOUNT OF SALES TAX RULES, 1994
FIXED AMOUNT OF SALES TAX RULES, 1994
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 5th
September, 1994]
S.R.O. No.858(I)/94, dated 5‑9‑1994.‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 50 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990, read
with subsection (4) of section 3 thereof, the Central Board of Revenue, with
the prior approval of the Federal Government is pleased to make the following
rules, namely:‑‑‑
1. Short title, application and commencement. ‑‑‑(I)
These rules may be called The Fixed Amount of Sales Tax Rules, 1994.
(2) They shall apply to the manufacturers of goods and
supplies specified in the Schedule to these Rules.
2. Definitions. ‑‑‑(I) In these Rules
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Act" means the Sales Tax Act, 1990;
(b) "Association" means the respective
association of the manufacturers of goods and supplies duly recognized by the
Federal Government;
(c) "Joint Survey Committee" means the Joint
Survey Committee constituted under sub‑rule (3) of rule 3;
(d) "Manufacturer" means the manufacturer of
goods and supplies specified in the Schedule;
(e) "Notification" means the Notification issued
under subsection (4) of section 3 of the Act determining fixed amount of sales
tax for particular goods or supplies; and
(f) "Schedule" means the Schedule to these
Rules,
(2) All other words and expressions used but not defined
in these Rules shall have the same meanings as are assigned to them in the Act.
3. Declaration to be made.‑‑‑(1) A
manufacturer liable to pay fixed amount of sales tax in accordance with the
Notifications issued under subsection (4) of section 3 of the Act and these
Rules shall make a declaration in writing to the Assistant Collector of Sales
Tax having jurisdiction for the financial year 1994‑95, by 20th
September, 1994 in the form specified in the Annex to these Rules.
(2) A manufacturer referred to in sub‑rule (1) who
intends to commence production of table goods during the course of a financial
year for the first time hall make a declaration in writing to the Assistant
Collector of Sales Tax having jurisdiction fifteen days before the commencement
of such production.
(3) The declaration shall be verified by a Joint Survey
Committee comprising one nominee of the respective Association, an officer of Sales
Tax, tot below the rank of the Deputy Superintendent of Sales Tax, nominated by
the assistant Collector having jurisdiction and the manufacturer or his
nominee, and of the declaration made under Association shall meet as soon as
the findings of the Joint Survey Committee are received by the Assistant
Collector.
4. Amount of fixed sales tax and date of payment.‑‑‑The
manufacturer shall deposit in advance the monthly fixed amount of sales tax
payable by him on or before the 10th day of the month preceding the month to
which the fixed amount of sales tax relates in the Government treasury:
Provided that the fixed sales tax for the months of July,
August, September and October, 1994, shall be paid by the manufacturers by the
20th of September, 1994 and the treasury challans (receipts) shall be forwarded
to the concerned Sales Tax Circle Officer for verification.
5. Notice of demand.‑‑‑(1) The Assistant
Collector of Sales Tax having jurisdiction, shall deliver to the manufacturer
within twenty days of the issue of Notification of the current financial year,
a notice of demand for the annual amount of fixed sales tax payable annually
alongwith the amount of monthly instalment.
(2) A manufacturer shall after depositing the monthly
fixed amount of sales tax due, produce a signed copy of the treasury challan
under which payment has been made to the Superintendent of Sales Tax having
jurisdiction by the 20th day of the month in which the payment was to be made.
(3) In the event of the manufacturer's failure to pay the
monthly amount of sales tax by the due date, notwithstanding any, other action
which may be taken against him under these Rule
